nodes.label: Contract: API for AI agents - MCP, REST, OAuth (v1)
AgentService
nodes.rationale: MCP layer is a thin adapter over common service; REST calls same functions (R-13)

nodes.label: MCP TypeScript SDK v2 (@modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4, spec 2026-07-28)
nodes.rationale: Stateless handler (new server instance per request); 2025 clients served via SDK compat path

nodes.label: Agent access rules (for-agents notebooks, grant, trash hidden)
Grant (static / oauth)
nodes.rationale: Revoking a grant immediately invalidates all its tokens

nodes.label: Shared notebooks for participant agents (D-54 amendment)
Token formats (dsa_, dso_at_, dso_rt_, dso_code_)
nodes.rationale: Only SHA-256 hex of tokens stored; tokens only in Authorization header, never URL

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen (server HTML, Quiet Paper)
nodes.rationale: No JS or external resources, CSP frame-ancestors none; request state in HMAC-signed form field (15 min)

nodes.label: Agent Markdown dialect (block markers, callouts, tasks)
Handwriting group (one writing pass, 2.5 s / 1.5 em rules)
Markdown escaping and verbatim round-trip
nodes.rationale: read_note -> edit -> read_note must yield the same text

nodes.label: edit_note operations (insert, replace, delete, move, replace_text; atomic)
Handwriting preservation on edits
nodes.rationale: replace_text changes only differing middle so Yjs items and stroke anchors survive; move rewrites anchors on the copy

nodes.label: Cross-notebook note move (one transaction, key rewrap)
Handwriting PNG renderer (@napi-rs/canvas)
nodes.rationale: Bundled fonts (Inter, Newsreader, Noto Emoji) so image is identical on any machine

nodes.label: AuditEntry journal
nodes.rationale: Audit write failure does not fail the operation

nodes.label: In-memory rate limits (120/min per grant, 30/min per IP for OAuth)
nodes.rationale: In process memory because no Redis (D-25)

nodes.label: Notebook name/icon/space duplicated in notebook doc meta
nodes.rationale: Coordinator decision 2026-10-25: server does not know encrypted names; fallback 'Untitled'

nodes.label: Agents do not create/rename/delete notebooks (E2E)
nodes.rationale: Notebook encrypted with user's master key which the server does not have
